l1.what: A tunnel on one floor and stairs between two v14 Levels gone through and back, from a GM's and a player's browser
recipe: On a scene with two Levels (Ground 0-10, Upper 10-20) draw a room on each floor and a tunnel on Ground, both secret; give both to a student
Turn on Verbose console logging for the GM and the player
The player presses Go through at the Ground tunnel and back; read each refusal's words and both consoles
The player goes up the stairs by Go through and back down; then the GM does the same on the student's token
Move the token upstairs with Foundry's own level control (no tunnel), then press Go through at the upper end; read the refusal and the token's elevation and level
Write down the scene, the regions' levels and elevations
l1.settles_if: agrees: every crossing goes both ways on both floors; defect: a refusal on the way back, with the console line naming the end's room
